flagged.comment: Required zoning district setback lines (front yard, rear yard, interior side yard, street side yard) are not clearly drawn as continuous boundaries, labeled, or dimensioned on the site plan. Individual point-to-point dimensions from buildings to property lines are shown (15.0' to 29.8'), but the required setback boundary lines themselves are not depicted. The Site Data Table on Sheet 9 identifies the zoning as MF-2 but does not specify the required setback distances.

Required zoning district setback lines are not shown, labeled, or dimensioned on the site plan, grading plan, or landscape plan for the northern, eastern, and southern property boundaries. Only the western boundary (Valley View Road) shows a labeled platted setback. All required yard setback lines for the MF-2 zoning district must be clearly drawn, labeled, and dimensioned on the site plan.

Zoning district setback compliance cannot be verified. While point-to-point dimensions from buildings to property lines are labeled on the site plan (ranging from 15.0' to 29.8'), the required minimum setback distances for the MF-2 zoning district are not shown on the plans. Without the required setback standards displayed, the applicant's compliance with LDC § 25-2-492 cannot be verified.

Compliance with zoning district setback distances cannot be verified because required setback lines are not shown with dimensions from property boundaries to buildings. No dimensions are provided on the site plan, grading plan, or landscape plan showing the distance from building faces to the northern, eastern, or southern property lines. Provide dimensioned setback lines for all property boundaries with required setback values clearly labeled.

Transformer pad clearances are not shown or noted. Four electrical transformer pads are located on the site (identified on Sheet 21 north of Building 2, between Buildings 4 and 5, west of Building 8, and south of Building 7), but no clearance zones, radii, standoff distances, or notes regarding Austin Energy Design Criteria 1.10.4 clearance requirements (10 ft, 5 ft, 12 ft, or 15 ft depending on structure type and location) are graphically shown or labeled. Compliance cannot be verified.

Transformer pad clearances cannot be verified. Sheet 21 (Preliminary Electrical Design Plan) shows transformer locations on the site, but no clearance dimensions or construction details are provided demonstrating compliance with Austin Energy Design Criteria 1.10.4. The criteria require specific minimum clearances based on building construction type (e.g., 12 feet to non-masonry buildings, 5 feet to brick/masonry). Provide a transformer pad detail sheet showing clearance dimensions to all adjacent buildings and structures with notation of building construction type to verify compliance.

Fences and retaining walls are shown on the site plan along the property perimeter (wood fence and concrete retaining walls noted on Sheets 9 and 31), but because required zoning setback lines are not drawn on the plans, the relationship between fence locations and building setback lines cannot be verified. Additionally, fence heights are not labeled.
areas: property perimeter fences and retaining walls

flagged.comment: Article 10 compatibility standards applicability has been incorrectly determined. The site is zoned MF-2, which is less restrictive than MF-4, and is located adjacent to an SF-3-zoned property. SF-3 is SF-5 or more restrictive and qualifies as a triggering property under § 25-2-1053. If the development is within 75 feet of this SF-3 property boundary, Article 10 compatibility standards apply. The applicant marked 'No' on the consolidated application for compatibility standards applicability, but this appears to be incorrect. Clarify whether the southern boundary is within 75 feet of the triggering property, and if so, prepare a compatibility analysis and revised plans demonstrating Article 10 compliance.
areas: Southern property boundary adjacent to SF-3 zoning

flagged.comment: If Article 10 compatibility is triggered (site within 75 ft of SF-3 triggering property), the required compatibility buffer is not shown at the correct width along the shared property line. The compatibility buffer must be 25 feet wide (or 15 feet if the development site is less than 75 feet wide measured from the shared triggering property line), shown as a landscaped zone complying with § 25-8-700 planting requirements, and extending along the full length of the property line shared with the triggering property. No such labeled and dimensioned buffer line appears on the site plan or landscape plan.
areas: Southern property boundary adjacent to SF-3 property

flagged.comment: Triggering property or properties are not clearly identified on the site plan compatibility sheets with all required information. While the site plan vision analysis identified adjacent zoning labels (SF-3 on south), there is no separate compatibility exhibit clearly labeling the triggering property with its zoning designation (SF-3) and dwelling unit count (required to confirm it qualifies as a triggering property under § 25-2-1053). Prepare a compatibility exhibit showing the triggering property location, zoning, and dwelling unit count, and clearly label it on all relevant plan sheets.

Separate compatibility exhibit is not provided or is incomplete. If Article 10 compatibility is triggered, the required standalone compatibility exhibit must show: property boundaries, on-site and off-site zoning boundaries (including all triggering properties and applicable combining districts), distances from triggering property boundary to existing and proposed structures, distances to surface improvements (parking, driveways, drainage features), and location of existing structures on triggering properties. This documentation is required to demonstrate compliance with § 25-2-1061 (height limits), § 25-2-1062 (buffer), and § 25-2-1063 (screening).

Fire department access setback compliance cannot be verified. Facts.md indicates the Valley View Road right-of-way width is 58 or 64 feet (determination required). Buildings are shown with dimensions from the west property line (26.1' for Building 1, 24.3' for Building 8), but the distance from the street centerline to building faces is not explicitly dimensioned on the plans, preventing verification of the 30-foot minimum setback requirement for streets with less than 60-foot right-of-way.
areas: buildings fronting Valley View Road (west side)

flagged.comment: Fire hydrant obstruction compliance cannot be verified. Fences and retaining walls are shown on the site plan, but fence heights are not labeled on any sheet. The Fire Protection Plan (Sheet 10) shows one existing and two proposed fire hydrants, but without labeled fence heights, the potential obstruction of hydrant access by fencing 4 feet or greater in height cannot be assessed.
areas: fire hydrant locations near Building 6, Building 7, and outside northwest corner

flagged.comment: Zoning variance need cannot be determined. While the site plan shows point-to-point distances from buildings to property lines, the required MF-2 setback standards are not displayed on the plans. Therefore, it cannot be verified whether any standard zoning setback reduction requiring a Board of Adjustment variance has been obtained, or whether such a variance is even necessary.

Letter of non-enforcement requirement cannot be verified. The site is within the recorded Mecey Subdivision (Vol. 73, Page 76, filed December 11, 1975), and platted setback lines may exist that differ from current code requirements. The plat is shown on Sheet 2, but the vision analysis did not identify any platted setback lines that differ from standard code. A review of the plat recorded instrument is needed to determine if a letter of non-enforcement from the City is required.

Fence height compliance cannot be verified. Wood fences and concrete retaining walls are depicted on the site plan sheets, but no heights are labeled on any sheet. The fence height limits under LDC § 25-2-899 (6 feet standard, 7 feet where grade change ≥ 1 foot, 8 feet under specific conditions) cannot be verified without labeled fence heights.
areas: wood fences and concrete retaining walls shown on property perimeter

flagged.comment: Fence design restriction compliance (post-July 31, 2023) cannot be verified. Wooden privacy fences are labeled on the Landscape Plan (Sheet 31, H.6), but detailed specifications regarding picket design, spike prohibition, barbed/razor wire prohibition, and knuckle selvage chain link requirements under LDC § 25-2-899(I) are not provided. Construction type and design details are insufficient to verify compliance.
areas: wooden privacy fences shown on site plan
